thread.title: Dow Movers: GE, DWDP

author: BNK Invest
title: Dow Movers: GE, DWDP
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Tuesday, shares of DowDuPont ( DWDP ) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 1.3%. Year to date, DowDuPont has lost about 4.5% of its value.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is General Electric ( GE ), trading down 1.1%. General Electric is lower by about 22.3% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Goldman Sachs Group ( GS ), trading down 0.7%, and Apple ( AAPL ), trading up 0.6% on the day.
